exceptions: mns:large_house_1, mns:medium_house, mns:large_blackstone_walls, mns:copper_tower and mns:mega_fortress are listed but do not start on this seed.

changed: One red haze over every biome (the basalt deltas' grey-lilac fog no longer shows).
Removed and shunned: the bridge piece (a sunken pit, no span), the lava-well kiosk and the crimson forge dome.
